knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: CZ-R1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Which identity is the law of total expectation?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Averaging the conditional mean over X recovers the unconditional mean.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Compute E[Y given X], then average over X.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Treating conditional expectation as the unconditional constant.

choices.label: E[Y] = E[Y given X] for every realised X.
E[Y given X] = E[X given Y] in general.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: CZ-R1
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Which formula correctly decomposes Var(Y) by conditioning on X?
hints: Use the concept from this learning objective only.
knowledge_checks.explanation: Total variance combines expected within-condition variance and variance between conditional means.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Omitting either the within-condition or between-condition term.

choices.label: Var(Y) = E[Var(Y given X)] + Var(E[Y given X]).
